# MIUI App Vault Mod **The MIUI App Vault with widgets unlocked on every device.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/stargazers)
> [!WARNING] > **Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated.** It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. HyperOS users: see [HyperOS App Vault Mod](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-App-Vault). ## Features - Widgets unlocked, with a new animation - Server switch for English widgets - "+" button to add widgets on low-end devices - New scroll animation on low-end devices - Fixes widgets not downloading - Works on CN, Global and EU ROMs ## Requirements - MIUI 12–13, Android 10 or newer - Magisk - Latest CN launcher and Themes app ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk. 3. Uninstall App Vault updates after rebooting. 4. Reboot your device. ## Notes - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs. ## Screenshots

MIUI App Vault Mod

The MIUI App Vault with widgets unlocked on every device.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/stargazers)

> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. HyperOS users: see HyperOS App Vault Mod.

Features

  • Widgets unlocked, with a new animation
  • Server switch for English widgets
  • "+" button to add widgets on low-end devices
  • New scroll animation on low-end devices
  • Fixes widgets not downloading
  • Works on CN, Global and EU ROMs

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 12–13, Android 10 or newer
  • Magisk
  • Latest CN launcher and Themes app

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_App_Vault_Mod/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • Uninstall App Vault updates after rebooting.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs.
